title: Kissed Crisp Filipino Sweet Potatoes Kare Kare
description: A salty, crisp, post-workout Filipino dish featuring sweet potatoes, wood-fired-baked to perfection, with a Mediterranean twist, in the form of kare-kare.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with peanut oil, fish sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and garlic until they are evenly coated.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the sweet potatoes in a single layer.
Bake the sweet potatoes in the wood-fired oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven and sprinkle with wood-fired sea salt.
Serve the kissed crisp sweet potatoes hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a side of steamed vegetables.
Traditionally, kare-kare is served with a side of bagoong, but feel free to omit it for a Mediterranean twist.
Enjoy your delicious and crispy Filipino sweet potatoes kare-kare.
